title: Finite-Time Electrometry with a Quantum-Regime Single-Ion Phonon Laser
summary: The phonon laser realized in a trapped ion, i.e., a self-sustained mechanical oscillator, has demonstrated the unique characteristics in practically detecting externally applied electric signals without the prerequisite of sideband cooling. Entering the quantum regime via sideband cooling is expected to further improve its sensing performance.
